T: He's got a hook on them...
D: A year after four friends dump a man they ran over on a coast road, someone in a fisherman's slicker starts sending notes and swinging a hook.
P: Serve the fish when Helen is crowned at the Croaker pageant.
S: Car boot crab cakes with remoulade
Golden crab cakes with remoulade. Julie finds crabs all over Max.

Mix the crab, 60g panko, egg, 3 tbsp mayo, mustard, seasoning and spring onions without breaking up the crab too much. Shape into 8 small cakes, press into the rest of the panko and chill for 10 minutes. Fry in the oil until golden, about 3 minutes a side. Stir the capers and gherkins through the rest of the mayo with a squeeze of lemon and serve alongside.
3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise, plus 125g for the remoulade@Pantry
1 tsp Old Bay or seafood seasoning@Spices
Southport hush puppies with honey butter
Cornmeal hush puppies with honey butter. Ray now works the fishing boats.

Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar and a pinch of salt, then stir in the egg, buttermilk and onion to a thick batter. Drop teaspoonfuls into oil at 180C and fry until deep golden, in batches. Beat the butter with the honey and a pinch of salt and serve with the hot hush puppies.
M: Croaker Queen fried whiting and chips
Fried whiting and chips with lemon.

Fry the chips at 150C until soft but pale, then drain. Dip the whiting in buttermilk, then in the cornmeal, flour and seasoning. Raise the oil to 185C and fry the fish until crisp and golden, then drain. Fry the chips again until crisp and salt them. Serve with tartare sauce and lemon wedges.
1kg floury potatoes, cut in thick chips@Produce
1 tsp Old Bay or seafood seasoning@Spices
Garlic prawns over creamy grits. Ray's boat is called the Billy Blue.

Bring the milk and 250ml water to a simmer, whisk in the grits and cook, stirring, until thick and soft. Stir in the cheddar and half the butter and season. Fry the garlic in the rest of the butter, add the prawns and paprika and cook until pink. Spoon the grits into bowls, top with the prawns and pan butter, spring onions and a squeeze of lemon.
W: Fourth of July banana pudding cups
Banana custard pudding cups with biscuits, for the Fourth of July parade.

Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, then whisk in the hot milk and stir over the heat until thick. Stir in the vanilla and cool with baking paper on the surface. Layer wafers, banana and custard in 4 cups, twice over. Top with whipped cream and a crumbled wafer.
K: Rum, pineapple, orange and lime punch. A fisherman in a slicker with a hook.
Stir the rum, pineapple and orange juice and the juice of 1 lime in a jug. Pour over ice, drip a little grenadine down each glass and add a lime wheel.
